Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_colum.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix A. No nonempty/cardinality premise. No stochastic or sign assumptions.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_colum.description: The absolute determinant is bounded by the product of column l1 norms, proved by the full Leibniz expansion and finite function-product identity.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_colum.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_colum.description: The absolute determinant is at most every common upper bound on any chosen column; partial-permutation injection is proved.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.column_l1_distan.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. All entries nonnegative and each column sums to one. Chosen row i and column j.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_of_sh.paper_statement: mxym/math 72d04aba5744ad940702e88a58073eb126229b6c, notes/integrated-witness-simplex-stability/paper.md, Explicit geometric conversion, prescribed-maximum-simplex stochastic-matrix paragraph.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_of_sh.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. All entries nonnegative and each column sums to one. Distinct columns j,k; common row i; any real δ; both W(i,j),W(i,k)>=1-δ. No smallness or δ>=0 premise.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.abs_det_le_of_sh.description: If two columns concentrate on one row, |det W|<=4δ by a determinant-preserving column difference and the column-l1 product bound.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.near_permutation.paper_statement: mxym/math 72d04aba5744ad940702e88a58073eb126229b6c, notes/integrated-witness-simplex-stability/paper.md, Explicit geometric conversion, prescribed-maximum-simplex stochastic-matrix paragraph.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.near_permutation.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. All entries nonnegative and each column sums to one. Real δ with 0<=δ<=1/8 and 1-δ<=|det W|. The δ>=0 binder is explicitly present but redundant in this stronger proof.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.near_permutation.description: There is a row permutation σ with W(σ(j),j)>=1-δ and column l1 distance from e_σ(j)<=2δ, simultaneously for every j.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.near_permutation.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. All entries nonnegative and each column sums to one. Real δ with 0<=δ<=1/8 and 1-δ<=|det W|.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.near_permutation.description: There is a row permutation σ with W(σ(j),j)>=1-2δ and column l1 distance from e_σ(j)<=4δ, simultaneously for every j.

Mxym.StochasticRigidity.exact_permutatio.paper_statement: mxym/math 72d04aba5744ad940702e88a58073eb126229b6c, notes/integrated-witness-simplex-stability/paper.md, Explicit geometric conversion, prescribed-maximum-simplex stochastic-matrix paragraph.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.exact_permutatio.assumptions_summary: An arbitrary finite index type ι with Fintype and DecidableEq, and a square real matrix W. No nonempty/cardinality premise. All entries nonnegative and each column sums to one. 1<=|det W|; no other determinant, rank or invertibility hypothesis.
Mxym.StochasticRigidity.exact_permutatio.description: W is exactly a permutation matrix: W(i,j)=1 if i=σ(j), and zero otherwise for one permutation σ.
